keyFindings.text: `route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml` declares the LLM Gateway endpoint `https://api.llmgateway.io/v1`, model id `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (display name "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"), and `reasoningEffort: max`, selecting the `off` / `high` / `max` ladder. The provider is `openai-completions` with `thinkingFormat: deepseek` and `supportsDeveloperRole: false`. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:9] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:14] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:24]

`route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml` declares the OpenCode Go endpoint `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`, model id `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, and `reasoningEffort: max` with the same `off` / `high` / `max` ladder. It uses the same `openai-completions` + DeepSeek thinking compatibility shape; its header says the endpoint is unverified until a keyed run proves it. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:10] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:15] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:25] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:2]

The other three patches declare no endpoint, model id, or reasoning effort: `guards.patch.yml` inserts the `repo-guards` plugin, `lineage.patch.yml` disables telemetry/session/goal/plan components and inserts a lineage-leaf marker, and `mcp-code-mode.patch.yml` mounts a `code_mode` MCP server over stdio. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/guards.patch.yml:3] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/lineage.patch.yml:2] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/mcp-code-mode.patch.yml:4]

ruledOutDirections.text: Inferring a base default route: both route patches override `agent-default-model`; the base default is not declared in these files, so no claim is made about it.
Searching outside `.dsh/patches/` for route declarations: the question is explicitly scoped to the checked-in patches, and no other source was needed.

Treating `mcp-code-mode.patch.yml` as a route patch: it declares an MCP server (`serverName: code_mode`, `transport: stdio`) and no provider, endpoint, model, or reasoning keys. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/mcp-code-mode.patch.yml:6]
